t: r/furniturerestoration on Reddit: What color Minwax stain should I buy? (more context in comments)
s: February 18, 2023 - Oak takes stain very evenly, and until the past decade was the most popular species for furniture/cabinets, which is why it’s on the can. Dense species like hard maple barely take stain at all. Softwoods are on the opposite end, taking a ton of stain unevenly. You can buy a few pieces of pine from the same batch and each piece would stain differently.
